strategies.name: Detection Strategy for LC_LOAD_DYLIB Modification in Mach-O Binaries on macOS

analytics.name: Analytic 0607
analytics.guidance: Detection focuses on unauthorized modification of Mach-O binaries to include LC_LOAD_DYLIB headers pointing to malicious dylibs. Behavior is identified via a chain of file metadata changes, removal of code signatures, and subsequent anomalous dylib loads at runtime. Correlation of file changes with lack of authorized updates and process memory mapping of unrecognized or unsigned libraries is crucial.

tuning.description: Correlates binary modification and dylib load within a defined time interval (e.g., 1 hour)
Regular expression to match known malicious or uncommon library paths
Number of unsigned or unrecognized dylibs mapped into memory per process
Scope monitoring to non-admin users or sensitive system directories
